author: TEDx Talks
description:
We send art to space, so why not send artists? Artist Laura J. Lawson acknowledges the artistry and creativity of the people who have gone to space so far, but also notes that these astronauts spend the bulk of their time doing science and engineering tasks. She asks, what if art was the mission, and not the down-time activity? Can art be the key to a global shift in perspective for how we take care of planet Earth? 

Laura J. Lawson is an interdisciplinary artist who connects the humanities to interstellar exploration. She has a B.A. from Austin College and an MFA from The University of Memphis. She was awarded a residency at the Centre d’Art Marnay Art Center in Marnay-sur-Seine, France, and was part of the first cohort of studio artists at the Cedars Union art incubator in Dallas. In 2026 she will join The Arctic Circle residency for a two-week voyage. 

Her work has been shown in Vignette Art Fair, New Texas Talent XXVII, the Amarillo Museum of Art Biennial, and in international j
title: Why we need artists on space missions | Laura J. Lawson | TEDxAustin College

author: TEDx Talks
description:
"Somehow, we've accepted that half the population can stand over a shared toilet, make a mess, and leave it for someone else to clean up—often the other half—but sitting down is the choice we ridicule.

Jay Hill takes this absurdity and follows it through the unwritten rules, invisible labor and quiet assumptions we've never bothered to question." Jay is a software engineering leader interested in how people and systems shape one another. He builds software for a living and community for connection, organizing PechaKucha Night, local tech meetups and justice-forward civic projects that bridge gaps and make things work a little better. He takes systems seriously, but not always himself. Jay lives in Asheville, NC with his family and a collection of half-finished projects. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Take a stand by sitting down… to pee | Jay Hill | TEDxAsheville

author: TEDx Talks
description: Dinner parties can change the world; and in an age of scrolling, shouting, and disconnection, that might be the most radical idea of all. In this TEDx talk, Ashley Berger explores how simple acts of hospitality—like inviting someone over for dinner—can foster real human connection, reduce loneliness, and create meaningful community. By shifting away from perfection, performance, and comparison, she shows how gathering around the table becomes an act of courage, presence, and hope. This talk is a powerful reminder that we don’t need more noise—we need more tables, more invitations, and more moments of genuine connection. Born and raised in Asheville, North Carolina, Ashley believes that dinner parties can change the world. As the founder and creative voice behind Sweetpea Lifestyle, she’s spent 18 years inspiring people to gather around the table through simple recipes, easy hosting tips, and the art of meaningful connection. Her TEDxAsheville talk, “Dinner Parties Can Change the World
title: Dinner parties can change the world | Ashley Berger | TEDxAsheville

author: TEDx Talks
description: As a rising social media star, Rajan Chidambaram knows all too well the accomplishments that tend to generate public celebration: high follower counts, impressive internships, and posts that project the perfect life. Chidambaram urges listeners to celebrate something less outwardly glamorous, the “wobble” of authentic personal growth. In his talk Chidambaram inspires listeners to embrace the cringe, doubt, and missteps that lie between you and your wildest goals. Rajan is a recent graduate of the University of Virginia who turned down a finance job at JPMorgan to pursue building micro resorts and doing content creation full-time. It’s led to 700K+ followers on social media platforms combined and an up-and-coming short-term rental business. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

description: In this talk, Moniek Dekker shares her experience biking from the Netherlands to Australia, exploring diverse cultures across multiple countries. Through her journey, she emphasises resilience, adaptability, and the value of stepping outside one’s comfort zone. Moniek Dekkers is a Physical and Health Education teacher and has been with IST for 5 years. She’s been teaching internationally for more than ten years and is passionate about learning through sports and adventure. She loves having the world in one classroom and hopes to inspire students to become independent and live active lives. She often ventures out to meet new cultures or take on a new adventure that involves traveling or sports. The road less traveled is about facing challenges, getting to know yourself and the world around you. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: A road less traveled | Moniek Dekkers | TEDxUpanga Youth

description: Drawing on his time with Tanzania’s Hadzabe hunter-gatherers, Tehsin Takim explores how ancient, wilderness-based survival strategies can transform modern leadership. He highlights practical lessons, focussed on trust, clarity, and shared purpose—to enhance how we lead ourselves and our teams. Tehsin Takim is an entrepreneur and communication coach whose perspective on leadership comes from experience spanning modern organisations and ancient ways of life. Drawing on time with the Hadzabe hunter-gatherers of Lake Eyasi, he shares practical leadership lessons that can transform how we lead teams, organisations and ourselves, grounded in trust, clarity and shared purpose. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: What an Ancient Tribe taught me about Leadership  | Tehsin Takim | TEDxUpanga Youth

description: Prejudice is something we should understand, interrupt, and change. Let's shift the narrative from “who are you?" to "who are we?" Traveler at heart and a bridge-builder by vocation. Polyglot and researcher with a deep curiosity for cultures, holding a Master’s degree in Multilingualism from the University of Konstanz in Germany and a Bachelor’s degree in Modern Languages in Colombia. Passionate about sociolinguistics and intercultural dialogue, he believes that every language we learn expands not only our vocabulary, but also our capacity to understand one another. Reflecting on personal experience and cultural discovery, the talk highlights how Afrobeats has evolved from its roots to a global movement, shaping not just sound but self-expression, language, and connection across the diaspora. From the legacy of Fela Kuti to modern global influence, this talk reveals how embracing cultural roots can give individuals the “wings” to connect, grow, and represent their identity on a global stage. Kamal Pereira is a 17-year-old with a passion for growth, movement, and culture. A dedicated basketball player, he brings energy, focus, and teamwork to everything he does on the court. description: The importance of equity, diversity, inclusion, participation and belonging are widely acknowledged, and there is also awareness that addressing these requires breaking down systemic barriers, rather than only surface structures. Concrete strategies for addressing the deeply rooted systemic barriers, however, are lacking. This talk bridges this specific gap by providing evidence-based and theory-driven strategies for breaking down the deeply rooted systemic barriers to participation and belonging of minority groups. These strategies are universal for any minority group, and in this specific talk, they will be contextualised and applied through examples of disability and cultural diversity. Natalia Skogberg is an Associate Professor, PhD, Chief researcher and Head of the Cultural Diversity Team at the Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare. She is a versatile and acknowledged researcher in the fields of diversity, health, and well-being. Natalia’s work aims at high societal impact, w

description:
Tomo Kotarski spaja dvije strasti – lokalnu kuhinju i pjesništvo – u priču o onome što hrani tijelo, ali i dušu.

Kroz autentičan pogled na tradiciju, okuse zavičaja i snagu izgovorene riječi, Tomo pokazuje kako hrana, vino i poezija dijele istu moć: okupljaju ljude, bude emocije i stvaraju uspomene. Tomo Kotarski is a sommelier and restaurateur from Sveti Ivan Zelina and co-owner of the restaurant Taverna 1860, which is ranked among the top 100 restaurants in Croatia.

Through his work, he is dedicated to wine culture, gastronomy, and creating authentic eno-gastronomic experiences that connect local ingredients, wines, and the traditions of the Prigorje region.

Earlier in his life, he was also active in poetry, primarily in the Kajkavian dialect. His poems have been published in collections from the contemporary Kajkavian poetry recital “Dragutin Domjanić,” with one of his more notable works being the poem “Odvratna.” This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference form
title: Pjesme, Vino, Hrana | Tomo Kotarski | TEDxSvetiIvan Zelina

title: Kad glazba prestane biti samo umjetnost | Luka Ratkajec | TEDxSvetiIvan Zelina

She holds a Master’s degree in Pedagogy and Portuguese Language and Literature and shares her knowledge through workshops, lectures, and mentorship programs. U ovom zanimljivom TEDx govoru Ivana Puhelek vodi nas kroz priču o gotovo zaboravljenoj vinskoj sorti Kraljevina – autohtonom blagu hrvatskog vinogradarstva koje ponovno pronalazi svoje mjesto na karti suvremenih vina. Ivana Puhelek is one of Croatia’s most prominent enologists, winemakers, and scientists, who has combined scientific precision with a family passion for wine into an outstanding career dedicated to viticulture and winemaking.

She graduated from the Faculty of Agriculture at the University of Zagreb and completed her academic excellence with a PhD, defending a dissertation focused on clone candidates and the chemical composition of wines from the indigenous variety Kraljevina.

Ivana is a key figure in the family winery Puhelek Purek, located in Gornje Psarjevo, where knowledge and tradition meet a modern enological approach. The winery is especially known for cultivating the Kraljevina variety. In 2022, their Sauvignon 2021 won a gold medal at the prestigious Decanter

description:
Rade Radolović govori o tremi – osjećaju kojeg svi poznajemo, ali rijetko razumijemo. Umjesto da tremu doživljavamo kao neprijatelja, Rade nas vodi kroz drugačiju perspektivu: što ako je trema zapravo naš saveznik? Rade Radolović is a Croatian theatre, television, and film actor, as well as a public speaking coach.

He was born in Pula on October 31, 1984—coinciding with both World Savings Day and Halloween. He studied acting at two drama academies, in Cetinje (Montenegro) and in Zagreb.

He has been performing in front of various audiences for 30 years. He has played more than 100 different roles and, alongside his acting career, has been leading public speaking workshops for over 20 years, attended by more than 1,300 participants—from young people to company executives.

Participants in his workshops learn practical techniques used by professional actors, helping them become more confident and successful speakers. He has hosted two TEDx events and also works as a TEDx mentor.

title: Bok,ja sam tvoja trema.Drago mi je da ćemo se bolje upoznati | Rade Radolović | TEDxSvetiIvan Zelina

description:
After winning Gladiators - the UK’s biggest fitness show - Amanda realised the real victory wasn’t the title, but changing how the next generation experiences movement. In this TEDx talk, she challenges the win-at-all-costs culture of sport and reveals how it quietly pushes too many children away from fitness. Her mission is to reimagine Physical Education so that confidence, health and belonging come before performance. Amanda wants every child to fall in love with movement and aims to prove that you don’t have to be sporty to do this. Fitness should not be about judgement, but instead be about creating a space where everybody can enjoy it and belong.
#Education #Fitness #Health #Movement #LGBT #Children Amanda is the BBC Gladiators 2025 Winner and Owner of Momentum Collective Gym in Warrington. She is a coach and strength athlete who has a deep passion for representation in fitness, especially for those left behind by traditional sport.

author: TEDx Talks
description: Why do most fitness journeys start strong and then collapse? Rishabh Telang reveals how the all or nothing mindset and your environment quietly sabotage your progress. This practical talk shows how small habits, identity shifts, and consistency not intensity are the real keys to lasting transformation. When Rishabh Telang opened Cult's first fitness center in Bangalore in 2015, gym penetration in India was just 0.2%. Most people who signed up quit within months. Rishabh didn't blame willpower. He blamed the system. A former basketball player and Wipro analyst, he had trained in elite facilities worldwide and noticed one consistent pattern: people show up when fitness feels social and non-intimidating. That became Cult's founding idea, machine free group workouts where beginners and athletes train side by side. Within a year, Cure.fit acquired Cult and scaled it nationally. Today, as Co-Founder at cult.fit, Rishabh has helped over a million Indians experience lasting transformation thr
title: Why Your Fitness Goals Keep Failing | Rishabh Telang | TEDxIIM Bangalore

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Why do some goals stay dreams while others turn into reality? Khurshed breaks down a powerful formula for success - clarity of what you want, why it matters, and how much it truly hurts to stay the same. This practical talk challenges you to stop drifting and start acting with intention before it’s too late. Khurshed Batliwala is a globally respected teacher, facilitator, and thought leader whose life’s work has been devoted to exploring the inner dimensions of human potential. Associated with the Art of Living Foundation for several decades, he has worked closely with students, professionals, educators, and changemakers across cultures, guiding them toward clarity, resilience, and conscious leadership.  

His work goes beyond motivation or instruction. It focuses on something more fundamental - cultivating inner silence, emotional balance, and a sense of responsibility that extends beyond the self. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently
title: A simple formula for success | Khurshed Batliwala | TEDxIIM Bangalore

Yugandhara Lad shares her journey from an orphaned child to rebuilding her life from a shelter home, defying societal expectations at every step. Yugandhara Lad is an entrepreneur, speaker, and social impact leader dedicated to empowering individuals from underserved backgrounds. Through her venture Virtualist, she focuses on identifying and nurturing talent from tier 2 and tier 3 regions in India, equipping them with the skills and confidence needed to succeed in the global workforce. Recognized with multiple national and international accolades, her journey stands as a powerful example of resilience, purpose, and transformation.  Ms Yugandhara Lad is an award-winning women-in-tech leader, entrepreneur, and philanthropist whose life journey stands as a powerful testament to resilience gu
title: Rewriting Your Story Against All Odds | Yugandhara Lad | TEDxIIM Bangalore

A oradora destaca que o corpo “grita” aquilo que a mente muitas vezes ignora, funcionando como um sistema de alerta, através da sua própria experiência como profissional e portadora de uma doença autoimune. Assim, compreender e cuidar das emoções pode ser essencial para prevenir e aliviar problemas físicos, reforçando como o cuidado da mente deve anteceder o cuidado do corpo para uma vida mais saudável e feliz. Isabel Pedroso Silva é uma nutricionista clínica portuguesa, autora e empreendedora na área da saúde digestiva e nutrição funcional.

Uma farmacêutica humanitária partilha a missão que nasceu na Guiné-Bissau, onde um laboratório se tornou muito mais do que resultados: um compromisso com ética, qualidade e ensino que capacita profissionais locais e salva vidas dos que não têm acesso a cuidados médicos - porque “um laboratório não é um resultadório”. Farmacêutica Humanitária, com missões de capacitação em medicina laboratorial na Guiné-Bissau e em São Tomé e Príncipe. Especialista em Farmácia Comunitária, Análises Clínicas e Genética Humana (OF).

Encontrar a nossa zona de conforto não significa estagnar, mas sim compreender onde nos sentimos seguros para crescer com consistência. Em vez de sair dela abruptamente, podemos expandi-la gradualmente, explorando novos desafios sem perder o equilíbrio. Assim, o crescimento torna-se mais sustentável e alinhado com quem realmente somos, encontrando o nosso superpoder no mercado e no mundo. description:
Ser artista hoje exige não só talento, mas também estratégia, posicionamento e visão de negócio. Quem espera reconhecimento abdica do controlo da sua carreira, enquanto quem assume o papel de “CEO” cria o seu próprio caminho, público e oportunidades. A arte continua a ser única e subjetiva, mas precisa de estrutura para se tornar sustentável. Alice Joana Gonçalves é jurista e consultora especialista na área das Artes. 

A sua primeira obra foi Apocalipse em 2012, que ganhou o Prémio de Performance Português. No mesmo ano, ganhou o prémio Frame Research Festival com Minus, uma performance de vídeo. Em 2013, colaborou com Julião Sarmento, artista visual, na realização de Five Easy Pieces e Notre Dame. Em 2014, voltou a ganhar o Prémio de Performance Português, com The Hunting, e foi convidada pelo Arte Institut (NY), a interpretar a sua performance no Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater.
